Info

Provides default demonstration SCARA DSL scripts and repository example file catalogs.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.dsl.document.example_catalog.DslExampleCatalog(*, examples_dir: Path, storage: IPlanStorageService)[source]¶

Bases: object

Repository resource provider for SCARA DSL demonstration and example scripts.

It defines:

attributes:
_DEFAULT_DEMO_SCRIPT - Hardcoded fallback demonstration script.
_examples_dir - Filesystem path to bundled examples directory.
_storage - Plan storage service for loading example scripts.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes the catalog with directory and storage service.
examples_dir - Returns filesystem path to examples directory.
get_default_script - Returns standard demonstration SCARA DSL script.
get_example_files - Returns sorted list of .scara files found in examples directory.
load_example_content - Reads and returns content of specified example script.
_DEFAULT_DEMO_SCRIPT: Final[str] = '# ==========================================================\n# SCARA DSL Industrial Pick & Place Demonstration\n# ==========================================================\nCONFIG ELBOW RIGHT\nSPEED RAPID 120.0\nSPEED WORK 40.0\nACCEL 500.0\nZONE BLEND R=5.0\nTOOL_ORIENT TANGENTIAL\n\n# Define sorting pallet grid (3 rows x 4 cols, 20mm pitch)\nPALLET_DEF TRAY ROWS=3 COLS=4 DX=20.0 DY=20.0\n\n# 1. Homing and rapid positioning\nHOME\nMOVE_J X=120.0 Y=50.0 Z=20.0 PHI=0.0\n\n# 2. Pick & Place arc jump to pallet index 0\nJUMP X=160.0 Y=80.0 Z=10.0 ARCH=25.0 SPEED=45.0\nAPPROACH DIST=10.0 SPEED=20.0\nPUMP ON\nWAIT_MS 100\nRETRACT DIST=15.0 SPEED=80.0\n\n# 3. Transfer to pallet cell 5\nMOVE_PALLET TRAY INDEX=5 Z=15.0\nPUMP OFF\nVALVE ON\nWAIT_MS 50\nVALVE OFF\n\n# 4. Circular inspection arc\nARC_CW X=150.0 Y=40.0 I=0.0 J=-20.0 SPEED=30.0\nHOME\n'¶
